WHAT THE OPERATOR SEES after this diff: Admin -> Instagram -> Create view, a 'Photo check' card ABOVE the Studio form (client/src/pages/admin/instagram/PhotoCheckCard.tsx mounted in InstagramAdmin.tsx). Idle: a 'Choose or take a photo' button and the line 'The photo is uploaded for this check only. It is not added to your shop photo library or used in posts.' After a photo: 'Uploading the photo...' then 'Checking the photo...', then the scorecard: '<overall> of 100', 'Model: <the provider that answered>' (or unknown), five sub-scores (Lighting, Framing, Brand presence, Cleanliness, Professional polish), Subject, Mood, Issues, What to change, Best for. A failed check reads 'Couldn't check this photo' with the cause and one button: 'Choose another photo' when the link was refused, 'Retry' (same upload, no second upload) otherwise; offline fails fast the same way. 'Make a branded version' opens an in-DOM confirm: 'Creates one new branded picture of a similar scene. It is not your photo edited. Uses image credit: normally one, a second if the first image service is down.', the prompt (300 chars, 'Show full prompt'), 'Make the picture' and 'Cancel' (focus returns to the button). The result: the picture, 'Preview only. Nothing was posted.', its model and 'Open full size'. Nothing posts anywhere. The Today view does not show the card (positive control).
